name: chat-panel
title: Chat panel
description: An AI assistant beside the product: a side panel with a header, the transcript (user bubbles, plain assistant replies with tool steps, typing dots and copy and feedback actions), a start screen with suggestion chips when the conversation is empty, and the composer with send and stop and the AI disclaimer. ChatThread is the same conversation without the panel, for a full page. Wire it to @atom63/agent or any runtime through props.
docs: Needs the Atom63 token stack and recipes in your CSS, as an @atom63/create app sets up: https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-templates
